INSERT INTO binaries (binary_id, executable_path, version, version_number, foldered_maps)
            VALUES($1, $2, $3, $4, $5)
            ON CONFLICT(binary_id) DO UPDATE SET version=EXCLUDED.version
            RETURNING
                binary_id "binary_id: i32",
                executable_path,
                version,
                version_number "version_number: i32",
                foldered_maps
